summary: The Community Library Association strongly supports the E-Rate program and expresses concern about any reduction or elimination of funding, emphasizing the essential role of E-Rate in providing broadband connectivity and infrastructure for libraries to fulfill their mission in the 21st century.

claims.argument: Without E-Rate support, increased telecommunications and infrastructure costs would place additional pressure on library budgets
claims.evidence_quote: For Cooper-Siegel and Sharpsburg, E-Rate is not a luxury or an outdated subsidy. It is an essential investment in the infrastructure that allows our libraries to fulfill their mission in the 21st century.
